study.title: NextGen NaCRRI TRICOT2
study.description: The National Crops Resources Research Institute (NaCRRI) under the NextGen phase II project has adopted the novel approach to participatory varietal selection, TRICOT (Triadic Comparisons of Technologies). The survey division team with support of the breeding team will evaluate the elite cassava clones selected in the first phase of the NextGen project in four regions: Central, Eastern, Northern and North Western in the districts of Luwero, Mityana, Serere, Kaberamaido, Dokolo and Arua. The team collects the data in three months intervals. Data co-produced by the National Crops Resources Research Institute (NARO) and Cornell University. This is the first cycle (April 2019 to June 2020; Arua, Dokolo, Kaberamaido, Luwero, Mityana and Serere) described in Nanyonjo AR, Angudubo S, Iragaba P, Brown D, Nuwamanya E, Esuma W, Ozimati A, Wembabazi E, Kanaabi M, Muhumuza N, Bayiyana I, van Etten J, de Sousa K, Tufan H, Kawuki RS (2024) On-farm evaluation of cassava clones using the triadic comparison of technology options approach. Crop Sci. 64, https://doi.org/10.1002/csc2.21293. Code and data of the paper at https://github.com/EQUAL-Lab/NextGen_Cassava_tricot_Uganda
